Here's what she remarked on:  - The box it comes in is really pretty!  - The oil removes makeup well and leaves her skin feeling soft (I verified this with a smootch on the cheek).  - But, then she started complaining about the tiny pump dispenser and how hard it was to use when her hands had gotten oily. reviews.t: Removes all traces of makeup gently.
reviews.x: This contains 10 different organic plant-based oils, with sunflower seed and jojoba oils being in the highest concentration.  It is of medium viscosity and will remove your makeup easily. I used it to remove eye makeup and there was no irritation. It has vanilla extract in it, so the smell is very pleasant.  This product is great for sensitive or dry skin, but of course all skin types can use it. Can also be used as a moisturizer for hair and skin, as well as a scalp oil.

This Vegan, Superfruit oil works well as a makeup remover and also helps hydrate my dry skin. Lately I’ve been using superfruit oils and I’ve found they keep my skin moisturized longer than using other serums.  It is pricey compared to other products in the market but the natural ingredients may be worth the extra money!  Thank you for taking the time to read my review and photos of this product. I hope it has been helpful in providing you with more information.

I’ve added this to my morning routine. I have a cleanser I use in the shower in the evenings, but it is so nice to rub this into my face in the morning. It takes off all the leftover darkened mascara around my eyes and then I take a hot washcloth and just wipe down my face. It feels fantastic! It leaves my face super moisturized and with a natural glow.  This product is a keeper. It also comes in a really sturdy glass bottle, which I like.

reviews.t: Why have I not tried this sooner?
reviews.x: I am horrible at skincare routines.  With this product, however, I feel it makes removing makeup and moisturizing my skin so much easier and not a hassle! You just need enough oil on your fingertips and gently massage into your face, and eye area to remove the makeup away.  It practically melts it off.  You then rinse it off using a warm,  damp face cloth, and you are done!  My face does not feel greasy. I recommend trying this product.

We've been wanting to give one of these organic makeup removers a try, and this one is really nice.  We didn't specifically need it to be vegan, but if that's important to you this will fit the bill.  It works well and is a nice sized bottle.  It smells really great (spicy/herbal.)  It's an oil, not a cream - so that's good to know.  Nice packaging too.

I love this stuff. Y'all, my 50 year old skin felt so smooth and soft after taking off my makeup I couldn't stop touching it.  It feels amazing.  Simple, clean, ingredients that smell and feel very natural, but wow... It melted my mascara, eyeliner and makeup right off and my skin has never felt so happy. I'm throwing my micellar water in the trash.

reviews.t: Takes my heavy makeup off with ease!
reviews.x: I wear heavy makeup some days for work and 8-10 pumps of this Vegan Mia Organic Facial Cleansing Oil takes it completely off! It leaves my skin feeling so soft and smooth and leaves zero skin irritations. Leave my skin hydrated, moisturized and well nourished. No greasy residue and skin looks great! Highly recommended!

this oil has little bit less slip but it really does remove everything off my face! i follow up with a foaming oil to remove all the bacteria and oil, skin is still nice and hydrated & CLEAN afterwards! great amount of product as well, if used so many other brands that aren’t as generous.

What a beautiful product. My skin is so dry in the winter and this really helps to hydrate the skin. A few pumps and it gets rid of all your makeup/sunscreen. I also have flaky skin and it helps to get rid of that too. I love all the ingredients in this. I would buy again!
This is nice. Smells good. Did not irritate my skin.

this product is so pretty and it just feels really fancy and high quality. The box is really beautiful (I got the strength one) it is an oil based makeup removing cleanser. I have oily acne prone skin so I do not usually use products like this but I am happy to say this did not make my acne any worse and it is gentle, I use it on my dry skin and then add a little water to it to get it going and then the makeup just wipes off. I have no problem with the pump because I absolutely need a full pump

I love the pretty box this came in and the bottle is of a nice hefty quality. The oil actually does remove makeup, including my waterproof mascara (with a couple of applications and some extended massaging), and it doesn't sting my eyes like some makeup removers. The directions say to use 8-10 pumps, but I think that's excessive. I use 3-4 at a time. reviews.t: A wonderful first step for your skincare routine.
reviews.x: This came lightening fast, I ordered and within 24hrs it was at my doorstep. I was shocked. The packaging is super cute and the bottle is made out of super heavy black glass. It looks luxurious and lovely on the counter top or a vanity! I can't say much for heavy makeup removal, as I only ever wear sunscreen, brow gel and a little mascara. But it worked wonderfully to remove the bit of makeup I had on. The jojoba and castor oil make this super hydrating, I love all the natural ingredients used i

reviews.t: Luxurious vegan make up removing oil
reviews.x: This Vegan Mia Superfruit Cleansing Oil + Makeup Remover is very luxurious.  I didn’t know what to think because it felt counterintuitive to slather oil on my face.  To my surprise it easily removed my makeup and left my face feeling soft and clean.  The first few times I used it I didn’t get all of the oil off of my lashes and it made my vision blurry.  I have since learned how to wipe it all off so that isn’t an issue.  I gave the scent 5/5 because it really isn’t scented and I prefer it that

reviews.t: More of a makeup remover than a cleanser
reviews.x: This product comes in a glass bottle with a pump dispenser. The dispenser has a very small spout, making it difficult to dispense the product without having it run down the side of the bottle. Note that there is oil in the name - it feels like an oil and goes on like an oil, with no foaming or cleansing at all. It also has a strong scent of lavender (which I like, but others may not).  This product works well as a remover for eye makeup. However, I don't feel that it does a good job of cleansing

This product smells as expected, given the ingredient list: natural and kernel-esque. Nothing exciting, but it literally boasts that it uses no artificial fragrances so, read the ingredients and expect the product to NOT smell like cotton candy.  I don't wear makeup most days so I only need 4 pumps for my face; last night I applied eyeliner to test the makeup-removing aspect. It came off easily. I wouldn't say 9 pumps are needed, that's very excessive for me. If you wear a LOT of makeup like I'v

reviews.t: Organic Cleansing Oil to remove waterproof eye make-up
reviews.x: The order comes in a jar of 100 ml in size. It's in a dark glass bottle. It's a cleansing oil to remove make-up. I use the cleansing oil to remove waterproof make-up like the eyeline or mascara that would otherwise need a lot of rubbing around the sensitve eye area with a regular cleanser. After the hard make-up is removed, I use the regular facial cleanser to wash my face.  The bottle has a pump that dispenses the oil. The cleansing oil is clear and has a nice scent to it from the cherry essent

First off, this isn’t like one of those precleanser type makeup removers. Don’t expect to add water and watch it turn milky.  I do 6-10 pumps and massage my face then wipe away with a wet paper towel. Sometimes I’ll cleanse afterwards with my usual routine and other times I just moisturize right after. reviews.t: Very moisturizing but doesn't remove makeup very well
reviews.x: The cleansing oil feels amazing on my skin but it doesn't do a great job removing makeup, especially eye makeup like mascara since the instructions say to use it dry. But I like using it after my primary cleanser as a way to add additional moisture to my skin. I'm sure it would do a better job removing the makeup if I used a cloth as the instructions state but I don't like using a cloth on my skin to remove makeup as it's harmful to your skin to exfoliate it daily like that. reviews.t: Great for Breaking Down Makeup, Lovely Scent
reviews.x: I really have been enjoying this cleansing oil as part of my usual nightly double cleanse.  The packaging is very nice, the glass bottle feels substantial and 2-3 pumps is about all you need. I think it will last a long time.  The oil itself is nearly clear, it has a lovely herbal scent but if you are sensitive to scents you may or may not enjoy it. claims.text: Reviewers frequently say the oil effectively removes makeup, including heavy and eye makeup, with ease.
Many reviewers report their skin feels soft, smooth, and hydrated after use.
Several reviewers praise the attractive packaging, including the box and bottle.
Some reviewers find the product too oily or greasy in texture.
A few reviewers mention the scent, with opinions ranging from pleasant to smelling like pepper.
